caption: The drawing depicts a textile or embroidery pattern on a light-colored, possibly beige or off-white background. The central composition features a stylized plant with a single main stem splitting into several curving branches, each bearing flowers and leaves. The flowers are large, with rounded and scalloped petals, and occur in colors including shades of red, pink, yellow, and blue. Some of the flower petals are outlined or shaded in blue and green. There are also smaller red buds and a few green-toned leaves, with the stems rendered in green or blue. At the base of the plant, there is a sinuous, dragon-like creature with a long, scalloped, and zigzag-edged yellow and green body, blue and green legs, and a dark blue, almost black, crest or mane along its back. The creature's position and curves integrate with the plant stem, adding a sense of movement to the composition. The fabric shows some wrinkles and age spots, and the edges are slightly frayed or taped.
title: Bedspread Detail
